title: "if you're working" fails to route self-employed applicants — a sole trader is working
evidence: +            "A written reference from your employer, if you\u{2019}re working \u{2014} or from a client, accountant, or business contact if you\u{2019}re self-employed.",
detail: The sweep's purpose is steering self-employed applicants away from employer references, but the new conditional ('employer, if you're working') describes self-employed people too. Same phrasing in copy.gleam and email_client.gleam.
recommended_fix: Use 'if you're employed' (or 'if you're in employment') instead of 'if you're working' in all three surfaces.
